scope.source_of_mechanism: Recovered 31.0–31.4 bounded SQLite transport; reviewed and adapted to current 30.12 contracts
scope.full_regression: Not executed by this agent; parent is responsible for final integrated verification
scope.data: Synthetic local values with real local SQLite processes and deliberate transport/process faults
scope.external_actions: None: no network, broker orders, deployment, credentials, model fit, financial experiment or exposure changes

modified.change: Startup handshake, bounded pending RPCs, deadlines, fatal process/transport errors, strict operation ACK validation, monotonic expiry at ACK processing, health, uncertain writes, no automatic replay/reopen, bounded close, JSDoc
Add startup ping; SQLite lock wait reduced from 30 to 1 second; import spacing

contract.open: Returns a promise resolving to this store only after a valid real SQLite ping ACK. Concurrent calls share the opening promise and child. READY cannot precede that ACK. Existing current runtime/server/crypto/cloud callers await open and remain compatible.
contract.acknowledgement: Exactly id plus either result or nonempty string error. Success result is validated against the pending operation: ping {ok:true}; batch true; CAS/lease boolean; scan up to 500 [string key, value] rows; get arbitrary JSON. Unknown/late IDs do not resolve pending work; malformed JSON never acknowledges it.
contract.time: RPC expiry uses performance.now(), a monotonic clock, starting after local serialization and before enqueue/write. A valid ACK processed at or beyond deadline fails the store even if I/O ran before the overdue timer callback.
contract.overflow: Reject overflow and all outstanding operations, latch FAILED, mark pending mutations uncertain, terminate worker; do not retry.
contract.transport_failure: Process spawn/error/exit, stdin/write error, RPC expiry or invalid response latches FAILED, rejects pending operations, releases timers and terminates the child.
contract.uncertainWrite: Sticky true if a mutation was awaiting ACK when transport failed, ACK was invalid/late, or close began. Not proof the mutation committed or rolled back. A read-only failure does not invent uncertain writes.
contract.definite_errors: Serialization failure before send and explicit valid operation error ACK reject without inventing transport uncertainty.
contract.atomic_retry: Existing up to four CAS attempts only after a valid false CAS result; no retry after lost/invalid/late ACK.
contract.reconciliation: A deliberately new store instance may inspect durable state after failed one is closed; caller must reconcile durable records and external exposure before resuming actions.
contract.close: Idempotent promise; reject pending RPCs and retain uncertainty; end input, then SIGKILL if close timeout elapses. CLOSED with uncertainWrite=true still requires reconciliation.
contract.schema: Existing records/leases schema retained; no audit_events or append_events ledger added.
contract.payload: No new smaller IPC byte limit. Existing upstream observation/registry limits remain unchanged. A 16 MiB value round-trip was explicitly verified.

cases: NEW/OPENING/READY startup ping and concurrent open compatibility
Spawn failure with sticky failure and no reopen
Suspended child deadline, released pending work and no retry
Committed CAS with ACK dropped, no CAS replay, explicit fresh reader finds one persisted increment
Five invalid mutation ACK envelopes/results: missing result, null, false, empty error, simultaneous result/error
Valid committed ACK after monotonic deadline rejected inside I/O callback before overdue timer can run
Pending queue capped at 2048 with read-only uncertainty semantics
Process death while mutation is pending
Close while mutation is pending; bounded stopped-child termination and retained uncertainty
Batch/get, 601-row pagination, scanAfter/limit, CAS/atomic and leases between two real SQLite processes
16 MiB stored value round-trip without smaller IPC cap
Local serialization and acknowledged unsupported operation errors preserve READY and definite-error semantics

limits: Node timers do not guarantee real-time termination while the event loop or OS is blocked; monotonic ACK validation prevents acceptance after logical expiry once processing resumes.
The RPC deadline begins after local JSON serialization. Serialization time and total caller work are not included in that bound.
The pending count is bounded, not total transport memory in bytes. Existing upstream payload quotas still apply; 16 MiB repeated-string compatibility is not an arbitrary-size memory benchmark.
Health READY reflects startup and last acknowledged operations; this port does not add a periodic independent health probe.

A storage failure may occur after an external broker request was already authorized or sent. This transport does not revoke external requests or guarantee protection operations while storage is unavailable.
No independent process supervisor or automatic external reconciliation was added; reactivation requires explicit current-runtime reconciliation.
POSIX signal fault tests are skipped on Windows by design; no such skip occurred on this Linux run.
No financial observations were created and no economic gate was advanced.
